Payout of 12 August is short ₹346.15.
The bank credited ₹1,59,193.27 against an expected ₹1,59,539.42. 16 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with refund rfnd_000041 of ₹346.15, issued 7 August against payment pay_000393. Refunds are deducted from the cycle that processes them, not the cycle of the original sale, so a payout can be reduced by a refund against a much earlier purchase.
Suggested action: verify rfnd_000041 in the refund report and confirm it was deducted from this payout. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- rfnd_000041 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
